overall: The gold is mechanically clean: verify_gold (0 failures) and cross_check with pdftotext (25/25 verified, 0 mismatches) both pass, every page_label matches the printed number, section paths match the printed headings, body_pages and its reason are correct, and all 10 key numbers were confirmed in body text on the page images (none taken from a chart; 0.55 and 40.8 also appear in figures but the gold uses the body). The problems are in content and wording. (1) Coverage of the focus chapter is unbalanced: the Executive Summary lists five main messages (p8-9); the gold covers message 1 (kp-11), message 3 (kp-10) and message 5 four times (kp-12 to kp-15, one per foundation), but has nothing on message 2 (process simplification as a pre-condition, arguably importance 3) or message 4 (uneven, non-inter-operable systems). Inflation, the Box 1.1 warning that the 6.7 percent deficit target may not be attainable, and the whole Monetary and Financial Sector section are also absent. To stay within 15 points, the drafter could merge two of the message-5 sub-points (e.g. kp-13 and kp-14) or drop kp-07, which partly overlaps kp-06's fiscal story. (2) Attribution: kp-01, kp-09 and kp-11 say 'The World Bank finds/expects', while p1 and p4 state the findings are staff views that do not necessarily reflect the World Bank's; use 'the report'. (3) Hedges: kp-15 hardens 'would benefit from' into 'needs'; kp-11 loses the trendline/perception framing. (4) Anchoring: kp-01 and kp-08 state content that is not in their quotes; extended quotes are proposed and were checked once on their pages.
